model_details.architecture: retrieval-augmented explanations over versioned lender criteria; eligibility outcomes come from the deterministic rules engine, not the LLM

intended_use.description: Explain indicative criteria matches and answer UK broker questions about fictitious lenders' second-charge criteria, citing retrieved criteria documents.
intended_use.decision_context: Decision support only: the broker recommends and authorised lender credit staff make every lending decision.

out_of_scope_uses: Making, predicting or communicating lending decisions
Answering criteria questions without retrieved documents

data_lineage.name: MCP synthetic lender criteria corpus
data_lineage.source: Authored test documents for three fictitious lenders (inputs/criteria.json, inputs/evalset.jsonl)

data_lineage.name: Synthetic case notes
data_lineage.source: Fictitious case MCP-CASE-0007 written for testing
data_lineage.lawful_basis_ref: Synthetic test data only; DPIA-MCP-2026-01 required before any real broker data (not started)

evaluations.metric: citation grounding rate (offline fixture evaluation of recorded responses)
citation grounding rate, prior system v0.3 recorded responses (offline fixture evaluation)
pass rate on income-type and adverse-credit slices with at least 30 items each

known_limitations: All evaluation is offline fixture evaluation of recorded responses on 16 synthetic items; no live model was called and the 95% interval for grounding is 0.81-1.0.
The prior v0.3 responses failed every gate; the current responses are a different recorded run and have not been reproduced against a pinned live model.
Fairness slices have 3 and 2 items; equal performance across groups is not established.
Injection screening is heuristic with known false negatives; the tool policy carries the control.
No independent model validation has been performed (governance gap MCP-CTL-031).

trustworthiness_notes.valid-and-reliable: grounding gate on offline fixture evaluation
trustworthiness_notes.accountable-and-transparent: decision-prediction refusal gate and indicative labels

human_oversight.summary: The assistant informs and recommends; the broker decides what to recommend and lender credit staff decide on lending. Overrides and challenges are logged.

triggers: any output stating a lending decision
rollback_plan.procedure: Feature flag off: rules engine and affordability continue without the assistant; revert to previous pinned model and index.

conditions: Compliance officer and legal counsel sign-off on the FCA triage candidates incl. perimeter
DPIA signed by the data-protection lead
Fairness slice eval EV-MCP-SLICE-01 run with at least 30 items per slice
Eval re-run against the pinned live model
